name: use-search
title: useCommandSearch
description: useCommandSearch: the search block's controllers as React hooks, for React DOM and React Native.
docs: Needs the search block (`npx better-supabase add search`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and a `BetterSupabaseProvider` above the component. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/search.
